mapper.sql: SELECT a.session_id, a.scene_id, b.scene_name, a.context_id, a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, c.bot_name, a.chat_status FROM bt_chat_scene_process a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene b ON a.scene_id = b.scene_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN bt_bot c ON a.bot_id = c.bot_id AND a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.scene_status = '1' AND c.status_cd = '00A'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_chat_scene_process ( id, session_id, tenant_id, bot_id, scene_id, scene_name, context_id, chat_status, created_time, status_cd, updated_time, creator_id, updator_id, remark ) VALUES ( #{dto.id}, #{dto.sessionId}, #{dto.tenantId}, #{dto.botId}, #{dto.sceneId}, #{dto.sceneName}, #{dto.contextId}, #{dto.chatStatus}, , #{dto.statusCd}, , #{dto.creatorId}, #{dto.updatorId}, #{dto.remark} )
mapper.select: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE c.bot_id = r.bot_id AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND b.scene_id = r.scene_id AND r.status_cd = '00A') AND a.chat_status = '1' ORDER BY a.created_time DESC 1

SELECT b.scene_id, b.scene_name, c.bot_id, c.bot_name FROM bt_bot_session a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene b ON a.bot_tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN bt_bot c ON a.bot_id = c.bot_id AND a.bot_tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.scene_status = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE c.bot_id = r.bot_id AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND b.scene_id = r.scene_id AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.is_default = 'T') 1

SELECT b.scene_id, b.scene_name, c.bot_id, c.bot_name FROM bt_bot_session a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene b ON a.bot_tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN bt_bot c ON a.bot_id = c.bot_id AND a.bot_tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.scene_status = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE c.bot_id = r.bot_id AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND b.scene_id = r.scene_id AND r.status_cd = '00A')

AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE c.bot_id = r.bot_id AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND b.scene_id = r.scene_id AND r.status_cd = '00A') AND a.chat_status = '1' ORDER BY a.created_time DESC 5
